lead_raw_text:
The structure of Co16N8 (reduced formula Co2N) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 143), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers with 10 geometric neighbors (2 Co, 8 N) and N centers with 9 neighbors (8 Co, 1 N), while the periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Co 10-vertex polyhedra and N 9-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Co polyhedra.
